marie: heads up — main CI turned red right after a fastmerge from @sam. test failing: smoke/gpu/kvcache-evict. Anyone grabbing?

ci-bot: Pipeline 1762626259 failed: smoke/gpu/kvcache-evict — OOM in gpu-allocator. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/1762626259

sam: that was my merge (PR #4820). I didn't touch allocator code; I changed checkpointing timing. Should I revert?

jin: can someone try a rerun first, could be a transient alloc blip.

marie: I'll kick a rerun, but if it repros we need a bisect. /ci rerun 1762626259

ci-bot: Rerun queued (1762626269). ETA ~8m.

alex: if rerun fails, let's bisect between main@a1b2c3 and merge@d4e5f6. @sam please hold subsequent merges.

sam: ack. pausing merges.

ci-bot: Rerun completed — failed again. same test. Snippet:
```
gpu0: alloc 12.7GB -> OOM at kv_alloc.cpp:142
stack: allocator::alloc -> kv::reserve -> checkpoint::write
```

ops: i can try to repro on a sim shard, will spin up smoke-matrix locally.

jin: starting bisect job now: `ci-bisect 1762626269 --range main~20..main` — will update thread when complete.

marie: thanks. @sam can you add `--kvcache=verbose` to the test run so we get evict traces?

sam: pushed a debug patch to my PR branch with extra logging: https://github.com/redwood/pr/4820. if bisect blames my commit i'll revert.

ci-bot: Bisect started: job 1762626310. I'll post results here.

alex: :thumbsup: i'm oncall if anyone needs pairing.
